ideas.pitch: A Python-based trading algorithm that ingests historical news headlines and social sentiment data using NLP, combining it with LightGBM to predict short-term asset price movements in the simulation environment.
ideas.title: AlphaSentiment: NLP & LightGBM Quant Strategy
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly builds on the winning architecture of Bito and SASBitathon by applying gradient boosting and NLP text classification to financial features, which appeals strongly to quant judges looking for alpha beyond pure technical indicators.

ideas.pitch: A quantitative asset allocation bot that uses Hidden Markov Models (HMM) to detect market volatility regimes in real-time, dynamically adjusting risk parameters and strategy weights during simulation ticks.
ideas.title: RegimeShift: Hidden Markov Model Portfolio Allocator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on risk-adjusted returns rather than simple high-frequency chasing, addressing the core evaluation priority of robustness in dynamic market environments.

ideas.pitch: An automated pairs trading algorithm that continuously computes rolling cointegration and Z-scores across correlated asset pairs provided in the simulation dataset, executing mean-reversion trades dynamically.
ideas.title: StatArb-Pairs: Cointegration-Based Statistical Arbitrage Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Statistical arbitrage is mathematically rigorous and notoriously difficult to execute cleanly; judges favor foundational quant finance strategies over overly complex neural networks that overfit.

ideas.pitch: A high-frequency Python trading bot that analyzes order book depth and volume imbalances to calculate toxic order flow and execute immediate market-making or momentum-following trades within the isolation constraints.
ideas.title: OrderBook-Imbalance: Tick-Level Flow Toxicity Bot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Exploits the 'speed is an edge' premise highlighted in the hackathon overview, demonstrating low-latency execution logic even within a simulated Python environment.

ideas.pitch: An ensemble trading system that combines multiple base signals (momentum, mean-reversion, and volatility breakouts) using meta-labeling to filter false positives before committing capital in the backtest.
ideas.title: MultiStrategy-Ensemble: Adaptive Meta-Labeling Allocator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Implements advanced machine learning meta-labeling techniques popular in institutional quantitative finance, scoring high on methodological sophistication.
